yefsywd4.variantName: My Christmas 6ft Artificial PCV Christmas Tree with 1150 Tips - Green
yefsywd4.sourceDescription: Bring festive cheer to your home with this Green Artificial Christmas Tree, featuring 1,150 PVC branch tips for a full, lush and traditional appearance. Made from high-quality PVC, it provides a reusable alternative to a real Christmas tree, allowing you to enjoy the festive season year after year. The durable hinged metal frame and sturdy folding base provide reliable support, while the three-section design makes assembly straightforward and storage convenient after Christmas. Simply connect the sections, spread out the branches and shape them to achieve your desired fullness. Decorate with your favourite baubles, tinsel and Christmas ornaments to create a festive centrepiece. Key Features: • 1,150 PVC branch tips create a full, lush and traditional Christmas tree appearance • High-quality PVC construction provides a reusable alternative to a real Christmas tree • Durable hinged metal frame offers strength and support • Sturdy folding metal base helps keep the tree stable • Three hinged sections allow straightforward assembly and convenient storage • Easy to shape and arrange the branches to achieve your desired fullness • Ideal for decorating with baubles, tinsel and Christmas ornaments • Suitable for creating a festive centrepiece in your home • Christmas fairy lights sold separately Specifications: • Product Type: Artificial Christmas tree • Colour: Green • Material: High-quality PVC • Branch Tips: 1,150 • Frame: Hinged metal frame • Base: Folding metal base • Sections: 3 hinged sections • Assembly: Connect sections and arrange branches • Lighting: Christmas fairy lights sold separately Read the operating instructions before use. Vivo Technologies Limited, Unit 11, Rainsford Road, London, NW10 7RG

w881hz02.sourceDescription: Our beautiful Woodland Pine Christmas Tree will add a touch of Christmas joy to any home this winter. Specifically designed for use outside, this tree has an anti-rust treated heavy-duty steel trunk and galvanised wire used for the branches and branch tips. It also comes with a heavy-duty metal stand with eight pegs to ensure that this tree survives all the elements of winter. This charming outdoor Xmas tree comes with professionally strung warm white LED lights which are sure to light up any garden or commercial space. Just remember, the transformer must remain dry at all times, so we recommend using a suitable dry box. Picture shows 8ft tree in our range. Want to compare your options? g4wk88c0.variantName: Charles Bentley 180cm Artificial Berries & Pinecones Christmas Garland - Green
g4wk88c0.sourceDescription: Our 180cm Christmas Garland with Berries & Pinecones combines lush, full green foliage with a rich mix of natural-style pinecones and berry clusters – the kind of abundant, layered look that instantly makes a mantelpiece, staircase, or doorway feel warm and welcoming. The mixed detailing gives this garland real visual depth – the varied textures of berry clusters and pinecones sitting against dense green foliage create a richly decorated finish that looks considered and styled. Pliable, lightweight, and 180cm long, it shapes easily to any space and stores compactly at the end of the season – making it a reliable, fuss-free Christmas staple you'll look forward to bringing out each year. Ideal for: Fireplace mantels, staircase banisters, doorways, windowsills, dining table centrepieces, and traditional or contemporary Christmas displays. Please Note: For indoor use only. Keep away from open flame and heat sources. Features: • Lush green foliage with a rich mix of berry clusters and pinecone accents • Abundant mixed detailing creates a rich layered finish • Works beautifully in both traditional and contemporary Christmas interiors • Pliable • Shapeable branches hold their position without additional fixings • Durable plastic construction – colour-fast no shedding no mess • Lightweight and easy to handle and position • Compact to fold and store between seasons Includes: • 1x Christmas Garland with Berries & Pinecones Materials: • Plastic (foliage • Berry • And pinecone detailing) Dimensions: H25, W25, D180cm Warning: for indoor decorative use only. Keep away from open flames, heat sources and ignition sources. Do not allow children or pets to play with the garland. Secure it so it cannot fall or create a trip or entanglement hazard. Charles Bentley North Road, Loughborough, Leicestershire LE11 1QJ
